Name: Kishi
Summary: Father of Ethan the Merarite singer, also called Kushaiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:44: Father of Ethan the Merarite singer, also called Kushaiah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Kishi in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
